subject: Clarify acceptable SOC 2 artifacts and timing for reissue
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 artifacts for procurement review

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the run-through on the demo last week. Procurement picked up our packet and is asking for the most recent SOC 2 Type II artifacts to finish the security review for our contract. The package we have from Redwood is labeled "SOC2_TypeII_2025_FINAL.pdf" and there is also a bridge letter dated 2026-06-01. Our policy requires 12 months of coverage ending within 90 days of the SOW start date; currently that means the report needs to cover at least through Feb 2027.

Can you confirm which artifact we should consider "authoritative" (final report vs. reissued bundle vs. bridge/interim attestation)? If there's a reissue in progress, please provide expected delivery date. Also attaching our SIG/CAIQ extract for the security team to populate.

Appreciate a short checklist of acceptable docs so procurement can close this out.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Park
Senior Sourcing Manager
Acme Health

Attachment: Acme_SIG_2027_Q1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts for procurement review

Hi Alice —

Thanks for raising this and attaching the SIG slice. Short answer up front: the authoritative signed Type II we have on file is the 2025 Type II (attached), and we issued a bridge letter to extend attestation into mid-2026. There was an administrative reissue (metadata and doc ID) that led to some customers receiving a bundle with a different filename; that likely caused confusion.

I'm looping Soojin (security) and Marissa (privacy/legal). Soojin — can you confirm exactly what artifacts the procurement team should accept for a contract starting in Mar 2027? Also Marissa, please confirm if the reissued bundle changes the legal acceptance for procurement.

For immediate convenience I've uploaded the signed 2025 PDF and the bridge letter to a secure link (see below). If procurement needs a short acceptance matrix (e.g., "accept bridge + signed report for contracts starting before X date"), we can provide that and a one-paragraph auditor statement.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Links: https://redwood-inference-secure.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2/SOC2_TypeII_2025_FINAL.pdf (signed report)
Attachment: SOC2_Bridge_Jan-Jun_2026.pdf (PDF, 34KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@acmehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts for procurement review — authoritative artifacts and reissue note

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the question — sorry for any confusion. Quick clarification:

- The signed, auditor-opinioned file "SOC2_TypeII_2025_FINAL.pdf" is the authoritative Type II for the 2025 audit period (covering 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31). The opinion is dated 2026-02-10.

- To maintain continuous coverage while the next Type II is assembled, our auditor issued a bridge letter ("SOC2_Bridge_Jan-Jun_2026.pdf") that attests there were no changes in control environment material to the prior period for the timeframe Jan 1–Jun 30, 2026. That bridge is commonly accepted by procurement teams for deals that start within 6 months of the bridge end date.

- There was an administrative reissue on 2026-07-08 where the auditor corrected a document ID in the bundle; content did not change, only the bundle metadata and file name. The corrected bundle is the same opinion + the bridge. If procurement has a strict policy that requires "reporting covering the last 12 months up to 90 days before start date" we can provide additional documentation (auditor inquiry letter or interim attestation) — but that is not a routine reissue.

What we recommend for your Mar 2027 SOW: accept the signed 2025 Type II plus the bridge letter covering through 2026-06-30. That combination provides continuous attestation into mid-2026 and demonstrates stable controls. If your legal/procurement policy cannot accept that, we will request an auditor-issued interim attestation (takes ~2 business days to request and depends on auditor availability).

I attached an evidence-index stub that maps common SIG/CAIQ questions to Redwood artifacts to speed your team's review.

Let me know which path you prefer and we'll action immediately.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_index_stub.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Alice Park <alice.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts for procurement review — authoritative artifacts and reissue note

Thanks, Soojin and Ben — this is helpful. Procurement is willing to accept the combination you suggested (signed 2025 Type II + bridge through 2026-06-30) provided we get: 1) a one-paragraph auditor confirmation that the reissue was administrative only (no control changes), and 2) the evidence index mapping to a few high-risk SIG questions (we'll highlight 6 items). Can you confirm the timeline to receive those two items?

If you can get the auditor confirmation within 3 business days that will let us proceed with the SOW signature next week.

Thanks,
Alice

Procurement Team, Acme Health
